Standard: The rescue hoist system has a means to jettison the cable (e.g., cut the cable), prevent inadvertent jettison of the cable, and secure the remaining cable to prevent whipping around the cabin and door as the load is released throughout the operating envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Conduct review of rescue hoist system documentation (e.g., drawings, system descriptions, system design analyses, and flight manual) to verify design features are in place to jettison cable and prevent inadvertent jettison of the cable (e.g., guarded switch) throughout the operating envelope. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct kinematic analysis to verify the release mechanism ability to jettison the cable with an external load.
  (2) Conduct an analysis to verify mechanism ability to prevent accidental jettison.
  (3) Conduct an analysis to verify mechanism ability to prevent whipping of cable no matter when cable is jettisoned throughout the operating envelope. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing to verify functioning of cable jettison and ability to prevent whipping of cable. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
      (1) Conduct a demonstration on the air vehicle to verify ability to prevent accidental cable jettison, functioning of cable jettison, and ability to prevent whipping of cable throughout the operating envelope.
